reasons.still_clip_tier: No video model is installed — scenes render as still images with a slow push-in.
reasons.backend_not_configured: This engine has nothing configured to render {task}.
reasons.model_ignored: "{model}" can't be run here, so another installed model will render {task} instead.
reasons.llm_server_down: The local script server is not running.
reasons.llm_model_missing: The script model "{model}" is not on the local server.
reasons.cloud_key_missing: No {provider} API key is set for "{model}".
reasons.cloud_model_unknown: No provider serves "{model}" for this kind of work.
reasons.comfyui_down: The image and video server is not running.

consequences.degraded: Renders still work, at reduced quality.
consequences.placeholder: A placeholder will be rendered instead.
consequences.placeholderMusic: The finished video will have no music.

scopeHint.session: Warn again next time you open LocalCut AI.
scopeHint.project: Never warn about these models in this project again.
scopeHint.always: Turn the warning off everywhere. Settings → General turns it back on.
